items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: Lorenzo Teo. He was a really outstanding class player.

ctx.x: Let's see. Any outstanding clarinet players? Or... Anybody who would make you cry, you know what I'm saying.
No, excuse me, but I'll tell you, Lorenzo Teo. He was a really outstanding class player.
What would he do at a funeral that would be a special?
